source.title: On open problems concerning distributional chaos for triangular maps

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL for document identifier 5964255. Direct shell fetch of https://zbmath.org/5964255 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH API was used only for resolver metadata. The API identified Zbl 1223.37015, DOI 10.1016/j.na.2011.07.052, and the title On open problems concerning distributional chaos for triangular maps.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted after metadata-only resolver recovery. Crossref confirmed the same DOI, publisher Elsevier BV, journal Nonlinear Analysis: Theory, Methods and Applications 74(18), pages 7342-7346 (2011), and exposed only Elsevier text-mining API links rather than an openly readable full-text artifact. OpenAlex confirmed open_access.is_oa=false, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.

Bounded recovery used exact-work searches for the exact title plus PDF, exact DOI plus PDF, the PII S0362546X11005347, and exact theorem phrases. Inspected candidates included the ScienceDirect article page, the ScienceDirect issue table of contents, a Grafiati bibliography page, Silesian University publication lists, and citing/reference pages. These were rejected because they were abstract-only or article-preview pages, bibliographic metadata, publication lists, search snippets, or citing-paper references, not a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the complete problem statements.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article's open-problem statements was recovered.

The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, Crossref or OpenAlex metadata, abstract-only pages, article previews, search snippets, or citing-paper references. The run therefore remains in needs_review with accepted empty.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-5964255.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
